g.text: Annual education spending per student (rupees, log scale)
Students at the 90th percentile spend 31 times those at the 10th
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files.
Sample: 1,464 students in rural Balochistan with spending > 0; 1,463 plotted.
One student at Rs 30 is outside Rs 100-1,000,000 and is excluded; all statistics are weighted by hhweight.
